text:
Books that were read on Nui Ba Den:
James Bond Books- I read and liked them all
Jean LaCarre, The Spy Who Came in From the Cold
Cowboy author, not Zane Gray but after Zane Gray, Louis L’Amour, he wrote books about New Mexico, Colorado. Every book he describes the area and he has walked the trails. He wrote hundreds of books.
Zane Gray was great as well. I really liked Zane Grey.

I enjoyed being on Nui Ba Den because of it being quiet. I could read and I stayed up at night with the Special Forces guys in case we were attacked.
